summary: Do not promise pixel-identical browser layout from a generic C# lowering without an explicit renderer/version/font/platform compatibility profile.

source.pattern: require pixel-exact browser layout for arbitrary CSS/document

target.notes: Use a defined renderer compatibility runtime/profile when pixel-exact output is a requirement.

semantics.policy: unsupported rather than false native claim

tests.name: normal
tests.input: arbitrary browser page rendered by an unspecified native UI toolkit
tests.expected_behavior: no generic semantics-preserving pixel-exact lowering is claimed

tests.name: edge
tests.input: same CSS across different installed fonts/platform text stacks
tests.expected_behavior: pixel geometry can legitimately differ without a pinned compatibility environment
